sum: Silvia, Inc. designs, develops, and operates an AI-powered personal CFO platform that helps investors manage, monitor, and analyze their financial positions in real time. The company's platform offers personal financial management tools, portfolio tracking, investment analysis, tax analysis, and AI-driven financial intelligence services. Its platform also enables users to consolidate and track bank accounts, brokerage portfolios, cryptocurrencies, real estate assets, loans, savings accounts, and other investment holdings through a single dashboard. The company was formerly known as ProCap Financial, Inc. and changed its name to Silvia, Inc. in September 2026. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in New York, New York.
ceo: Mr. Anthony John Pompliano III (Founder & CEO)
